layer: P2a.5 CPU-only diagnostic audit plus independent FK/Join-Instance data-quality gate
research_question: Can the already-frozen P2a ranking and budget-selection differences be attributed to lexical coverage, stable-ID ties, schema-text features, or token-budget packing, and can FK/Join-Instance identity and label coverage be made auditable without treating reference SQL as semantic role truth?
core_hypothesis: P2a BM25/RRF losses may be traceable to lexical zero-overlap/ties or to context-packing loss; FK/Join-Instance uncertainty is a separate data-quality gate. This audit does not predict that a new ranking method will improve results.
success_criteria: Verify the P2a source commit, P1.6 cache, input manifest, S0 score digest, complete row counts, and P2a aggregate from preserved artifacts.
Reconstruct the full P2a run with the frozen scorer and match all per-question rows and aggregate metrics exactly; preserve the P2a NO-GO decision.
Produce aligned-by-ID Gold column rank-transition matrices for all 1,460 eligible questions and the 706-question non-saturated cohort, plus all three token budgets.
Quantify BM25 lexical overlap, zero-score candidates, tie groups, top-K boundary ties, and schema-text feature strata without publishing per-question rows.

Validate all stored FK JoinInstance IDs against their canonical ordered-pair identity, reproduce the archived FK/JOIN denominators, and assign one structural reason to each unmatched parsed JOIN ON clause.
Choose whether evidence supports a newly preregistered P2b representation or packing experiment; do not start that follow-on in this run.
stop_conditions: Any P2a/P1.6 source, artifact, input-manifest, vector-cache, or score-digest mismatch.
Any row replay, aggregate metric, S0 parity, data denominator, JoinInstance ID, or archived FK/JOIN summary mismatch.
Missing private per-question ranks or incomplete FK artifacts.
CPU time above 1,800 seconds, process RSS above 16 GiB, or more than 8 CPU threads.

criteria: frozen P2a source and cache hashes match
all three methods replay the five archived rows exactly
FK artifact has 103 raw instances across 11 databases

data.dataset: BIRD dev; exploratory development data only

references.protocol_scope: P2a.5 A and C only. No new ranking/model scores, no P2b execution, and no change to prior P2a NO-GO.

methods.scorer: Import the scorer only from the pinned P2a commit; replay its BM25/RRF and Cosine rankings against the frozen P1.6 float32 cache.
metrics: Gold-column rank transitions aligned by stable node ID
FK identity and JOIN ON coverage
methods.classification: Mechanical evidence labels only; semantic mismatch, Gold ambiguity, and causal schema-text noise require blinded human review and will remain unresolved.

runs.failure: Implementation KeyError while mapping frozen P1.5 aggregate field names; no aggregate result was produced. The output directory is retained.
Implementation KeyError because text-feature accumulators were initialized with a nested shape but consumed as flat counters; no aggregate result was produced. The output directory is retained.

outputs.publication_boundary: Only README, this configuration, runner source, and aggregate_summary.json are public. No question IDs/text, Gold SQL, per-question ranks, schema values, vectors, databases, or logs are included.
